discovery: Every Item 2.02 8-K for the 23 already-accepted Milestone 1 issuers, filed in the event window; record every exclusion
universe: The 23 issuers with an accepted Milestone 1 event, no others -- see candidate_universe below

candidate_universe.note: Fixed by the 23 already-accepted Milestone 1 events (config/m1-events.json); not sampled or discovered. Identical issuer set to Milestone 2 step 2's own.

minimum_note: Deliberately minimal, mirroring Milestone 2 step 2's own reasoning: a depth extension to measure real review throughput further back in time, not a coverage target.
selection: Enumerate before reading returns; no performance-based sampling
scope: Daily regular-session previous-close-anchored labels only; intraday events quarantined
acceptance: A second depth extension for the same 23 issuers, same full review standard as Milestone 1 and Milestone 2 step 2; not evidence of predictive power

authorization.decision: Milestone 2 step 3: extend the same 23 issuers by 2 more prior quarters, to build a real per-issuer time series deep enough for Milestone 4's own walk-forward validation. Real data checked before proposing a window: every issuer (including KLC, a 2024 IPO with the shortest real history of the 23) has at least 4 real Item 2.02 filings available before its own already-used earliest event.
authorization.words: expand the real event dataset first; ... depth: more quarters per existing issuer; ... yes go ahead

relationship_to_step_2: A separate, parallel protocol. It does not amend, extend or touch config/m2-step2-*.json, config/m2-combined-events.json, or any Milestone 1/2/2-step-2 record. Its event window (2024-11-01 to 2025-06-01) ends the day step 2's own begins (2025-06-01), so the two candidate pools cannot overlap.
